note: Starting assumptions for downside-case-model. 'kind' is 'sourced' (a published figure) or 'assumption' (a placeholder the leader must confirm). readiness-setup copies this file to the workspace as assumptions.json, which becomes the assumption register that policy-radar and the leader update over time.

pfs_cf_change.label: Medicare physician fee schedule conversion factor change, 2027
pfs_cf_change.note: -2.31% for non-qualifying APM clinicians; use -1.83% for qualifying APM participants. A year-end congressional fix would change this; policy-radar watches for it.

ma_share_tied_to_pfs.label: Share of Medicare Advantage revenue paid as a percent of the Medicare fee schedule
ma_share_tied_to_pfs.note: Check MA contracts. Many pay a percent of Medicare, so fee schedule cuts flow through.

medicaid_subject_share.label: Share of Medicaid revenue from adults subject to work requirements
medicaid_subject_share.note: Replace with the expansion-adult share from D02 as soon as a roster exists. Set to 0 in the seven states not subject.

medicaid_disenroll_rate.label: Share of subject adults who lose coverage during 2027
medicaid_disenroll_rate.note: Severe anchors on CBO's full-implementation ratio: about 5.3 million uninsured by 2034 from work requirements out of roughly 18.5 million adults subject (Georgetown CCF summaries of CBO). 2027 losses should run below that. Leader must confirm.

hold_harmless_elected.label: State elected the CMS hold-harmless period (disenrollments start July 2027)
hold_harmless_elected.note: policy-radar updates this per state as elections are announced.

exchange_volume_loss.label: Drop in exchange (ACA marketplace) patient volume

source.name: HFMA citing HCA (15% to 20% drop in ACA volumes)

exchange_volume_loss.note: HCA's projection for its own exchange volumes. Base sits below that range for organizations with little exchange exposure.

exchange_losers_uninsured.label: Share of exchange patients losing coverage who become uninsured

uninsured_utilization_drop.label: Drop in use of care after losing coverage
uninsured_utilization_drop.note: HCA's figure is for exchange enrollees; applying it to Medicaid losses is an assumption.

self_pay_collection_rate.label: Share of self-pay billings eventually collected
self_pay_collection_rate.note: Replace with the organization's own self-pay recovery from D07.

commercial_share_renewing.label: Share of commercial revenue under contracts renewing in 2027
commercial_share_renewing.note: contract-renewal-radar replaces this with the real figure.

commercial_renewal_change.label: Average rate change on 2027 commercial renewals
commercial_renewal_change.note: Employers expect 8.2% benefit cost growth in 2027 (Marsh) and 59% plan cost-cutting changes, so payers will push. Applied for half the year on average.

opex_growth.label: Operating expense growth, 2027
opex_growth.note: Kaufman Hall reports hospital total expenses up 21% over three years; physician practices vary. Replace with the budget.
